ios.desc:
Stoic Journal helps you capture your day-to-day thoughts with clarity by removing unnecessary decorations and distractions. Export directly to Notion from stoic journal app, It eliminates brainrot and allows you to focus on pure, creative writing.

Features of Stoic Journal:

A simple, easy, and distraction-free way of journaling.

Home Screen Widgets for quick journaling

Keep your diary safe with a traditional password lock.

Enjoy sleek, customizable themes.

Meaningful analytics — no more overwhelming statistics.

Fast calendar search to revisit past entries.

A weekly letter from your future self.

Daily reminders to build a disciplined journaling habit.

Share your favorite diary entries with friends and family.

Export to Notion.

Record your Virtues Everyday for gratitude and self actualization.

Wellness features like breathing exercises, Meditation, Habit tracker, Gratitude, Mood Journaling with tracking.

Stoic Journal helps you embrace the practice of stoicism by removing distractions and keeping your focus where it belongs — on your writing.
